title: What Makes Content Truly Valuable on Blockchain?
body: In a decentralized content ecosystem, defining value becomes an interesting challenge. Is value measured in engagement metrics, community impact, or long-term relevance? As blockchain platforms continue to evolve, we're seeing new ways of assessing content worth beyond traditional metrics. Some creators focus on building communities, others on sharing specialized knowledge, and many aim to spark meaningful discussions. What do you consider valuable content on platforms like Steem? How do you decide which posts to support through your curation? The diversity of content approaches suggests there may be no single answer—value might be subjective and context-dependent. As the platform grows, we might develop more nuanced ways to recognize different forms of contribution. What content stands out to you, and why do you think it resonates with the community?
